description: Look up coins GORZ has graded by ticker, name or address (e.g. "$BONK", "fuzzy bear"). Returns up to 8 matches with their contract address, first GORZ grade and what happened an hour later. Use this to get the address, then gorz_check_coin for the full safety read. Tickers are not unique: many coins copy the same name.

query.description: Ticker, name or address to look for

title: Find a Solana coin on GORZ by ticker or name
